title: cestrum fasciculatum
intro: Cestrum fasciculatum, commonly known as the night-blooming jasmine, is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and exhibiting anticonvulsant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cestrum fasciculatum include its sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its use in treating anxiety disorders and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
